RainDance Homes for Sale in Windsor, Colorado

Discover Luxury Living

Explore the exquisite RainDance National Resort & Golf Course Community in Windsor, Colorado, a haven offering a spectrum of luxurious homes and custom sites designed to cater to your upscale lifestyle.

About the RainDance Community

RainDance stands out as a master-planned community, celebrated for its extensive amenities and stunning architectural designs. It's home to the prestigious RainDance National Golf Course—a top-tier 18-hole course crafted by PGA Tour Champion Fred Funk. This course offers a unique blend of challenging gameplay and breathtaking views, ensuring a premium golfing experience. Adjacent to this is the RainDance River Resort, the largest aquatic park in the region, featuring a resort-style swimming pool and a lazy river, perfect for family fun and relaxation.

Community Amenities and Lifestyle

RainDance boasts a 13-acre park perfect for family outings and sports, along with a vibrant array of community events and activities that strengthen the neighborhood spirit. Its strategic location near I-25 makes it effortlessly accessible to neighboring cities such as Fort Collins, Greeley, and Loveland, enhancing its appeal for both commuters and those seeking a blend of leisure and convenience.

Unique Amenities

Experience the multifunctional Hoe Down Hill, usable year-round, transforming from a sledding hill in winter to a venue for outdoor movies and local festivals in summer. The community pool at RainDance goes beyond the ordinary with its resort-style design that includes a lazy river, catering to all ages and providing ample space for both active fun and relaxation.

Experience the blend of luxury, community, and nature at RainDance—where every detail is designed with you in mind.

Homes and Custom Homesites

At RainDance, choose from a broad range of new home constructions and tailor-made homesites. Property options vary from luxurious homes starting in the upper $600s to premium custom golf course homesites priced in the mid $400s. Each neighborhood within RainDance, like Festival and Sugar Hills, offers full access to all community amenities, ensuring a complete and enriching lifestyle.
